result.title: Trainable at Depth, Solvable at Small Size: What the Loss Surface of a Polynomial Activation Dictates for Designing, Initializing and Training Networks
result.summary: What makes a deep network train, and what shape is its loss surface? We answer both with one construction at two scales: a polynomial activation f (z) = z + λz 3 , clamped and projected onto the unit sphere, plus an unnormalized identity path. As a deep stack it trains to one hundred layers on MNIST with no normalization machinery; as a small model its square loss is a polynomial system we solve exactly. The small scale explains the large one: it prescribes how to design, initialize and train the stack.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究多项式激活 f(z)=z+λz³（截断并投影到单位球）加恒等路径的网络：深层堆叠在 MNIST 上无需归一化即可训练至百层，小规模模型的平方损失可精确求解为多项式系统，用以解释深度堆叠的设计、初始化与训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于深度可训练性、初始化与损失面几何的分析，可能为深层 latent 迭代推理（loop 式状态更新的稳定性、长度泛化与训练监督设计）提供可供核查的方法线索，但需确认是否可用于多模态场景。
